fusions.name: Rote Vein
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 28 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. It always lands as a critical hit, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Studied Landing
fusions.desc: You leap up to 6 tiles onto the target and deal 12 damage. It is left 10% easier to wound and [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Muscle Memory
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities still waiting, chosen at random, and hops you 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Perfected Spring
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover give your next strike 15% more critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
